LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.MaterialEffectToolti: How strongly the chosen material's properties carry over to the finished armor. 100% means the full difference between that material and plasteel is applied. Plasteel itself always produces the vanilla item. Changes take effect after restarting RimWorld.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.AllowedCategoriesToo: Which kinds of material may be used to build the supported armor. Metals are always available; other categories are optional. Changes take effect after restarting RimWorld.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CatMetallicLocked: Metals are required and cannot be disabled.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CleanupButton: Clear material settings on all supported armor
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CleanupTooltip: Clears the chosen material on every supported armor item in this save, returning it to the vanilla default. Do this before removing the mod. Afterwards, save and exit.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CleanupNone: No supported armor items were found in this save.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CleanupDone: Cleared the material setting on {0} supported armor item(s).
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CleanupRemaining: Still found {0} supported armor item(s) with a material setting. Run the cleanup again.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.CleanupSafe: No custom material settings remain on supported armor. You can remove the mod, save and exit.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.SafeToRemove: You can remove the mod. Please save and exit directly.
LanguageData.StuffablePowerArmor.NeedsRestart: Changes take effect after restarting RimWorld.
